== Biography ==
John was born about 1850. He is the son of [[Glasgow-971|Alexander Glasgow]] and [[Smith-228705|Ellen Smith]]. 

John followed a military path and served in the 4th Dragoon Guards, a distinguished cavalry regiment of the British Army. He was noted in Limerick, Ireland, as the eldest son of Alexander Glasgow, esq. of Auchinraith. His presence there may have been related to his military service or other official duties.<ref>https://archive.org/details/gentlemansmagaz101unkngoog/page/443/mode/2up?q=%22John+glasgow%22</ref>

144 Hope Street<ref>https://archive.org/details/postofficeannual18381839g/page/n97/mode/2up?q=%22Alexander+Glasgow%22</ref>
